title: selaginella rupestris f. dregei
intro: Selaginella rupestris f. dregei, commonly known as a variety of the Rupestris Spikemoss or Rock Spikemoss, is a type of evergreen plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella rupestris f. dregei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effectiveness and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
